name: Vodafone
look: Monumental uppercase display at weight 800, one red on pill-filled and pill-outline buttons, and a two-band dark/light rhythm.

hero.title: TOGETHER WE CAN
hero.sub: Unlimited 5G on a network that publishes its coverage honestly, with a price that does not double after the first year.

features.title: A tariff you can read
features.sub: The industry's tricks — the year-two rise, the fair-use asterisk, the roaming surprise — removed one at a time.

items.title: Honest coverage
items.body: A map based on measured signal, not modelled prediction, with the difference explained.

items.title: No year-two rise
items.body: The price you sign up for is the price for the whole contract. It is written into the terms.

items.title: Roaming included
items.body: Seventy destinations at no extra cost, with the fair-use limit stated as a number.

items.title: Genuinely unlimited
items.body: No speed cap after a hidden threshold, and no traffic management on the unlimited plans.

items.title: Change any time
items.body: Move up or down a plan monthly without a fee or a retention conversation.

items.title: Keep your number
items.body: Ported within one working day, with the old contract cancellation handled for you.

showcases.title: A speed you will actually get
showcases.body: Advertised speeds are the minimum guaranteed to the majority, not a peak nobody reaches. If yours falls below it, you can leave without penalty — that is in the contract rather than the marketing.
points: Guaranteed minimum speed in the contract
Leave without penalty if it is not met
Engineer visit included if it is not

showcases.title: Connectivity with an SLA
showcases.body: Business lines carry an availability SLA with compensation defined in advance, and a support number answered by an engineer rather than a script.

testimonial.quote: The bill in month thirteen was the same as month one. I had genuinely forgotten that was possible.
testimonial.name: Rachel Adeyemi

pricing.title: PLANS
pricing.sub: No year-two increase. Written into the terms.

items.a: Yes, for the contract term, written into the terms rather than promised in marketing. There is no annual inflation-linked increase.
No data cap and no speed reduction after a threshold. Traffic management applies only to the two lower tiers and is described in the plan detail.

items.q: How accurate is the coverage map?
items.a: It is built from measured signal reports rather than propagation modelling, and the methodology is published. Where confidence is low, the map says so.

items.q: Can I leave if it is bad?
items.a: Within thirty days, yes, for any reason, with the handset returned. After that, broadband customers can leave without penalty if the guaranteed minimum speed is not met.

cta.title: SWITCH TODAY
cta.sub: Thirty days to change your mind, and a price that stays the same.

notes: Massive uppercase display at weight 800 is the signature; weight-300 siblings handle the calmer secondary moments.
One red carries every CTA — pill-filled for primary, pill-outline for secondary. There is no third button variant.
The speechmark orb is the only decorative chrome that is not a call to action, and it anchors the centre of the page.
Pill geometry on every interactive shape: 60px on buttons, 32px on inline badges, with card chrome staying at 6px.
The page rhythm is two bands — dark hero, light content. There are no mid-tone greys; contrast does the elevation.
